title: 終わらぬ祭りを御覧じろ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One has been invited to a press conference alongside Oguri Cap and Super Creek, and I accompany them.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: All three of you have had historic success this year. How does it feel to be called the Eternal Top Three?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I feel like it came outta nowhere, so my gasts were flabbered at first, but it actually feels pretty nice to have such a cool title!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm gonna work hard to live up to it…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Nah, that's not right.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna blow everyone's expectations so far away, that title'll have to work hard to live up to me!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Oh my! What a statement! Super Creek, Oguri Cap, may I ask you two the same thing?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: How do you feel about being dubbed a part of the Eternal Top Three?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It's an honor to be given such a marvelous title, but I also consider it a reminder for us not to be content with our current standing.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: I see! So you wish to perform in a way that exceeds your title, just like Inari One.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I don't feel like I deserve to be called one of the Top Three.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ Actually, I feel the same way Oguri does.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: And why is that?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: We still haven't won against Inari. We lost at the Mainichi Okan, the autumn Tenno Sho…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: As well as at the Japan Cup and the Arima Kinen. Inari won all of those races. Given that…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: We can't consider ourselves the "Top Three." Not when Inari is clearly the strongest among us.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: That's why the two of us would like to issue a declaration here today.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Inari, we're going to beat you next time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: We'll prove we're worthy to be part of the Top Three.

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter…

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: W-wow! The competition between you three hasn't cooled down in the slightest! I can practically feel the sparks flying!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Pfft… Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oguri and Creek, you two really are the best! Things'd be way too borin' without the both of ya keepin' me on my toes!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Don't think I'm gonna let ya steal the win that easily, though! I'll lay my title on the line and tear up the track like I always do!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sounds like a new festival awaits the three of us.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And to quote a dear friend, "You can't put on a festival alone."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right, Inari? ♪

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Exactly!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Listen up, everyone! You'd better share this next part far and wide, so the whole world knows!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Our festival here is not over yet! In fact, brace yourselves, 'cause we're just gettin' started!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, the electrifying press conference comes to an end. Everyone appears excited to see what the three of them have in store next!
